---
title: "Region x Time: expert robustness"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
---

Robustness check for `10_region_time.Rmd`: same sample, questions, region x time model and priors, but without
the entries of experts with at least `min_entries` entries in the sample (religious groups in Southwest Asia,
Europe, Africa and East Asia, without eHRAF and Pulotu, start year from 3000 BCE to 1500 CE; conflicting answers
left out). Experts are counted on the full window (any answer), as in `scratch/expert_counts.py`, and identified
by the lower-case name in `model_data.csv` (so "Ltaief Zorgui" and "ltaief zorgui" count as one expert).

Second alternative: the full sample with a random intercept per expert. Only the region x time model is fit.
Slopes are compared with the full-sample fits of `10_region_time.Rmd`, which must have been run first
(`fits/region_time_region_time_*`).

Run from inside `modeling/` after `3_prepare_data.py` and `10_region_time.Rmd`. Fits are saved in `fits/`
(`region_time_experts_<set>_*` without the prolific experts, `region_time_experts_re_*` with an expert intercept;
delete them to refit), figures in `fig/region_time_experts/`.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(posterior)

options(mc.cores = 4, brms.backend = "cmdstanr")
dir.create("fits", showWarnings = FALSE)
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 11))

# figures: shown in the session and saved as fig/region_time_experts/<name>.jpg
fig_dir <- "fig/region_time_experts"
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
save_plot <- function(p, name, width, height) {
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".jpg")), p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  p
}

regions <- c("Southwest Asia", "Europe", "Africa", "East Asia")
sample_colors <- c("full sample" = "#a3a29b", "without prolific experts" = "#d6402a", "expert intercept" = "#2a78d6")
year_min <- -3000
year_max <- 1500
min_entries <- 5  # experts with at least this many entries in the window are left out
```

# Data

```{r data, message = FALSE}
source_of <- read_csv("../data/sccsrv3/entry_data.csv", col_select = c(entry_id, data_source)) |>
  distinct(entry_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

d_window <- read_csv("data/model_data.csv") |>
  left_join(source_of, by = "entry_id") |>
  filter(
    poll == "group",
    world_region %in% regions,
    is.na(data_source) | (data_source != "eHRAF" & !str_starts(data_source, "Pulotu")),
    year_from >= year_min, year_from < year_max
  ) |>
  mutate(region = factor(world_region, levels = regions), time = year_from / 1000)

# entries per expert in the window
entries <- d_window |> distinct(entry_id, entry_name, expert, region, year_from)
per_expert <- entries |>
  group_by(expert) |>
  summarise(entries = n(), regions = paste(sort(unique(as.character(region))), collapse = ", "),
            first = min(year_from), last = max(year_from), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(entries))
excluded <- filter(per_expert, entries >= min_entries)
```

Window: `r nrow(entries)` entries by `r nrow(per_expert)` experts. Left out: `r nrow(excluded)` experts with at
least `r min_entries` entries, together `r sum(excluded$entries)` entries
(`r scales::percent(sum(excluded$entries) / nrow(entries))` of the window).

```{r data_excluded}
print(excluded, n = Inf)
```

Entries per region, kept and left out:

```{r data_regions}
entries |>
  mutate(sample = if_else(expert %in% excluded$expert, "left_out", "kept")) |>
  count(region, sample) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(share_left_out = scales::percent(left_out / (kept + left_out), accuracy = 1))
```

```{r data_sets}
# conflicting answers (Yes and No for the same entry and question; weight < 1) are left out, as in 10_region_time.Rmd
d_all <- d_window |> filter(weight == 1)
d <- d_all |> filter(!expert %in% excluded$expert)

# parent question of each family of child questions
parent_of <- c(monitoring = "supernatural monitoring present", shg = "supreme high god present")

# child questions in topic order (as in 4_baseline.Rmd)
topic_order <- c(
  "murder coreligionists", "murder other religions", "murder other polities", "non-lethal fighting",
  "prosocial norm adherence", "lying", "honouring oaths", "property crimes", "economic fairness",
  "gossiping", "laziness", "shirking risk", "disrespecting elders", "sex",
  "ritual observance", "performance of rituals", "taboos", "personal hygiene", "sorcery",
  "conversion non-religionists",
  "knowledge this world", "causal efficacy the world", "indirect causal efficacy the world", "communicates with living",
  "is unquestionably good", "positive emotion", "negative emotion",
  "is anthropomorphic", "possesses hunger", "is sky deity", "is chthonic",
  "permissible to worship other god?",
  "is monarch fused", "is monarch manifestation", "is kin to elites", "other elite loyalty"
)
all_questions <- c(unname(parent_of), topic_order)

questions <- d_all |>
  distinct(family, question_short) |>
  filter(question_short %in% all_questions)
stopifnot(setequal(topic_order, filter(questions, family != "parent")$question_short))

make_sets <- function(x) {
  list(
    parent = x |> filter(question_short %in% parent_of), # as answered (no "No" inferred for the supreme high god since 2026-11-23)
    conditional = x |> filter(question_short %in% topic_order, !inferred)  # child questions as answered
  )
}
sets <- make_sets(d)
sets_all <- make_sets(d_all)
runs <- bind_rows(
  tibble(set = "parent", question = unname(parent_of)),
  tibble(set = "conditional", question = topic_order)
)
```

Entries per question and region without the prolific experts (in brackets: full sample), and share "Yes" among
the entries of the prolific experts and of all other experts (the difference shows where they pull the data):

```{r data_questions}
count_region <- function(s) {
  bind_rows(s) |> group_by(question = question_short, region) |> summarise(n = n_distinct(entry_id), .groups = "drop")
}
full_join(count_region(sets), count_region(sets_all), by = c("question", "region"), suffix = c("", "_all")) |>
  mutate(n = sprintf("%d (%d)", replace_na(n, 0L), n_all)) |>
  select(-n_all) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = region, values_from = n, values_fill = "0 (0)") |>
  arrange(match(question, all_questions)) |>
  print(n = Inf)

bind_rows(sets_all) |>
  mutate(by = if_else(expert %in% excluded$expert, "prolific", "others")) |>
  group_by(question = question_short, by) |>
  summarise(n = n(), yes = mean(answer_value), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = by, values_from = c(n, yes)) |>
  mutate(across(starts_with("yes_"), ~ round(.x, 2))) |>
  arrange(match(question, all_questions)) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

# Models and fit

Two alternatives to the full-sample region x time model of `10_region_time.Rmd` (same priors, compiled once with
`chains = 0` and refit for each question with `update()`):

- **without prolific experts**: the same model on the sample without the experts listed above.
- **expert intercept**: the full sample, with a random intercept per expert,
  `answer_value ~ 0 + region + region:time + (1 | expert)`. An expert's entries then count as related rather than
  independent, and the expert standard deviation (log-odds) says how much experts differ beyond region and time.
  Prior on the SD: half-normal(0, 1). Most experts have a single entry per question, so the SD is learnt mainly
  from the experts with several entries (see "Expert intercept: can it be estimated?" below).

```{r fit, message = FALSE, results = "hide"}
model <- bf(answer_value ~ 0 + region + region:time)
model_re <- bf(answer_value ~ 0 + region + region:time + (1 | expert))

# brms names the region coefficients without spaces (regionSouthwestAsia, regionSouthwestAsia:time, ...)
region_key <- setNames(regions, str_remove_all(regions, " "))
priors <- reduce(
  map(paste0("region", names(region_key)), ~ set_prior("normal(0, 1.5)", class = "b", coef = .x)),
  c,
  .init = prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b")
)
priors_re <- c(priors, prior(normal(0, 1), class = "sd"))

templates <- list(
  without = suppressWarnings(brm(model, data = sets$parent, family = bernoulli(), prior = priors,
                                 chains = 0, refresh = 0, silent = 2)),
  re = suppressWarnings(brm(model_re, data = sets_all$parent, family = bernoulli(), prior = priors_re,
                            chains = 0, refresh = 0, silent = 2))
)

# without: fits/region_time_experts_<set>_<question>.rds; re: fits/region_time_experts_re_<set>_<question>.rds
fit_question <- function(variant, set, question) {
  path <- sprintf("fits/region_time_experts_%s%s_%s.rds", if (variant == "re") "re_" else "", set, question)
  if (file.exists(path)) return(readRDS(path))
  data <- if (variant == "re") sets_all else sets
  fit <- update(
    templates[[variant]],
    newdata = filter(data[[set]], question_short == question),
    chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000, seed = 125123, refresh = 0,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99)
  )
  saveRDS(fit, path)
  fit
}

# full-sample fits from 10_region_time.Rmd
read_full <- function(set, question) {
  path <- sprintf("fits/region_time_region_time_%s_%s.rds", set, question)
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("missing ", path, ": run 10_region_time.Rmd first")
  readRDS(path)
}

fits <- runs |>
  mutate(
    fit_full = map2(set, question, read_full),
    fit_without = map2(set, question, ~ fit_question("without", .x, .y)),
    fit_re = map2(set, question, ~ fit_question("re", .x, .y))
  )
```

# Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
diagnostics <- fits |>
  select(set, question, fit_without, fit_re) |>
  pivot_longer(c(fit_without, fit_re), names_to = "variant", names_prefix = "fit_", values_to = "fit") |>
  mutate(diag = map(fit, function(fit) {
    s <- summarise_draws(as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^(b|sd)_", regex = TRUE))
    tibble(
      max_rhat = max(s$rhat),
      min_ess_bulk = min(s$ess_bulk),
      min_ess_tail = min(s$ess_tail),
      divergences = sum(subset(nuts_params(fit), Parameter == "divergent__")$Value)
    )
  })) |>
  select(variant, set, question, diag) |>
  unnest(diag)

# worst values per variant
diagnostics |>
  group_by(variant) |>
  summarise(max_rhat = max(max_rhat), min_ess_bulk = min(min_ess_bulk), min_ess_tail = min(min_ess_tail),
            divergences = sum(divergences))

# fits with any problem
diagnostics |> filter(max_rhat > 1.01 | min_ess_bulk < 400 | min_ess_tail < 400 | divergences > 0)
```

# Expert intercept: can it be estimated?

Posterior of the expert SD per question (mean and 95% interval), with the prior's median and 95% quantile (dashed).
A posterior that looks like the prior means the data say little about it. Next to it: the number of experts with
at least two entries for the question (they carry most of the information on the SD).

```{r expert_sd}
expert_sd <- fits |>
  mutate(est = map(fit_re, function(fit) {
    v <- as_draws_df(fit, variable = "sd_expert__Intercept")$sd_expert__Intercept
    tibble(mean = mean(v), lower = quantile(v, 0.025), upper = quantile(v, 0.975))
  })) |>
  select(set, question, est) |>
  unnest(est)

multi <- bind_rows(sets_all) |>
  distinct(question = question_short, expert, entry_id) |>
  count(question, expert) |>
  group_by(question) |>
  summarise(experts = n(), experts_2plus = sum(n >= 2), entries_2plus = sum(n[n >= 2]), .groups = "drop")

expert_sd |>
  left_join(multi, by = "question") |>
  mutate(question = factor(question, levels = all_questions), across(c(mean, lower, upper), ~ round(.x, 2))) |>
  arrange(question) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r expert_sd_plot, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 9}
prior_q <- qnorm(c(0.75, 0.975))  # half-normal(0, 1): median, 95% quantile
p_sd <- expert_sd |>
  left_join(questions, by = c("question" = "question_short")) |>
  mutate(
    panel = case_when(set == "parent" ~ "parent", family == "monitoring" ~ "monitoring", TRUE ~ "supreme\nhigh god"),
    panel = factor(panel, levels = c("parent", "monitoring", "supreme\nhigh god")),
    question = factor(question, levels = rev(all_questions))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(mean, question)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = prior_q, colour = "grey60", linetype = "22") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), size = 0.15) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Expert SD (log-odds)", y = NULL) +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
save_plot(p_sd, "expert_sd", 7, 9)
```

# Slopes: full sample and the two alternatives

```{r estimates}
summarise_slope <- function(value) {
  tibble(mean = mean(value), lower = quantile(value, 0.025), upper = quantile(value, 0.975), p_positive = mean(value > 0))
}

# region slopes per draw, plus their average
region_slopes <- function(fit) {
  draws <- as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^b_region.*:time$", regex = TRUE) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    select(.draw, starts_with("b_")) |>
    pivot_longer(-.draw, values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(region = unname(region_key[str_remove(str_remove(name, "^b_region"), ":time$")])) |>
    select(.draw, region, value)
  average <- draws |> group_by(.draw) |> summarise(value = mean(value)) |> mutate(region = "average")
  bind_rows(draws, average)
}

sample_labels <- c(full = "full sample", without = "without prolific experts", re = "expert intercept")
estimates <- fits |>
  pivot_longer(starts_with("fit_"), names_to = "sample", names_prefix = "fit_", values_to = "fit") |>
  mutate(
    sample = factor(sample_labels[sample], levels = sample_labels),
    est = map(fit, ~ region_slopes(.x) |> group_by(region) |> reframe(summarise_slope(value)))
  ) |>
  select(sample, set, question, est) |>
  unnest(est) |>
  left_join(questions, by = c("question" = "question_short")) |>
  mutate(
    panel = case_when(set == "parent" ~ "parent", family == "monitoring" ~ "monitoring", TRUE ~ "supreme\nhigh god"),
    panel = factor(panel, levels = c("parent", "monitoring", "supreme\nhigh god")),
    question = factor(question, levels = rev(all_questions)),
    region = factor(region, levels = c("average", regions))
  )

slope_plot <- function(est) {
  ggplot(est, aes(mean, question, colour = sample, group = fct_rev(sample))) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), size = 0.15) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = sample_colors) +
    labs(x = "Time slope (log-odds per 1,000 years)", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
    theme(legend.position = "top", strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
}
```

## Average of the region slopes

The main estimate of `10_region_time.Rmd` (mean and 95% interval) in the full sample, without the prolific
experts, and with an expert intercept.

```{r slopes_average, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 13}
p_average <- slope_plot(filter(estimates, region == "average")) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y")
save_plot(p_average, "slopes_average", 8, 13)
```

Mean of the average slope in each sample, change from the full sample, and the probability of a positive slope:

```{r slopes_average_table}
estimates |>
  filter(region == "average") |>
  mutate(sample = names(sample_labels)[match(sample, sample_labels)]) |>
  select(sample, question, mean, p_positive) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = c(mean, p_positive)) |>
  transmute(
    question = factor(question, levels = all_questions),
    mean_full = round(mean_full, 2),
    change_without = round(mean_without - mean_full, 2),
    change_re = round(mean_re - mean_full, 2),
    p_pos_full = round(p_positive_full, 2),
    p_pos_without = round(p_positive_without, 2),
    p_pos_re = round(p_positive_re, 2)
  ) |>
  arrange(question) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

## Slopes per region

East Asia has no prolific experts, so leaving them out does not change its slopes; Europe loses the most entries.

```{r slopes_region, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 14}
p_region <- slope_plot(filter(estimates, region != "average")) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ region, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y")
save_plot(p_region, "slopes_region", 16, 14)
```
